sprites.name: Glass pipe network
sprites.note: Full-width plate layer, drawn first. Ink rims, 30 % sky-blue glass so the background shows through. Bubble-sized feed tube (45 pt) into the next holder. Flip X for the right-hand layout

sprites.name: Back gear · r 24 art px
sprites.note: 14 teeth. Turns only while a rotate button is held: 1/4 tooth per 1/12 s, neighbours counter-rotate (mech_gears). Positions in MECH.GEARS

sprites.name: Rotate left · up
sprites.note: Bone push slab, engraved arrow; the whole 43 × 76 pt slab is the touch zone. Left-hand layout x 0 / 43.3, right-hand 273.3 / 316.7; y = plate top + 28

sprites.name: Rotate left · held
sprites.note: Held: face sinks 4 pt, lip gone, inner shadow on the top and left. Bone push slab, engraved arrow; the whole 43 × 76 pt slab is the touch zone. Left-hand layout x 0 / 43.3, right-hand 273.3 / 316.7; y = plate top + 28

sprites.name: Rotate right · up
sprites.note: Bone push slab, engraved arrow; the whole 43 × 76 pt slab is the touch zone. Left-hand layout x 0 / 43.3, right-hand 273.3 / 316.7; y = plate top + 28

sprites.name: Rotate right · held
sprites.note: Held: face sinks 4 pt, lip gone, inner shadow on the top and left. Bone push slab, engraved arrow; the whole 43 × 76 pt slab is the touch zone. Left-hand layout x 0 / 43.3, right-hand 273.3 / 316.7; y = plate top + 28

sprites.name: Hurry shout bubble
sprites.note: Last 4 s. Solo: centered (180, 567), over the board straight up the aim line, bottom 6 pt above the danger line. Battle half: centered art (108, −10) above the pointer. 2 spike frames, bob 1.7 pt. countdown_digit on top; no baked text

sprites.name: Pointer container (fire touch zone)
sprites.note: Center = art (108, 46): screen (180, 716.7) solo. Holds the loaded bubble, does not rotate. Tap = fire (55 pt circle); pointer_tap on press

sprites.name: Next-bubble holder
sprites.note: Art (180, 61) left-hand / (36, 61) right-hand. The feed tube enters from the inner side. Next bubble at full cell size

sprites.name: Pointer chevron on brass stick
sprites.note: Same center. Rotate to the aim angle. Stick starts at the rim; the tip reaches 59 pt out

sprites.name: Back gear · r 11 art px
sprites.note: 10 teeth. Turns only while a rotate button is held: 1/4 tooth per 1/12 s, neighbours counter-rotate (mech_gears). Positions in MECH.GEARS

sprites.name: A · crank (dog aims)
sprites.note: Center art (76, 70). 45° per 1/12 s while aiming, synced with dog_aim_*; drawn behind the dog

sprites.name: B · steering wheel (cat aims)
sprites.note: Center art (86, 74). 15° per 1/12 s while aiming; drawn before the cat so the paws sit on the rim

sprites.name: Back gear · r 9 art px
sprites.note: 8 teeth. Turns only while a rotate button is held: 1/4 tooth per 1/12 s, neighbours counter-rotate (mech_gears). Positions in MECH.GEARS

sprites.name: Back gear · r 8 art px
sprites.note: 8 teeth. Turns only while a rotate button is held: 1/4 tooth per 1/12 s, neighbours counter-rotate (mech_gears). Positions in MECH.GEARS

sprites.name: A · fire lever arm
sprites.note: Rotates about its base: rest −0.5 rad, half −0.15, pulled 0.25 (mirror the sign for right-hand). Synced with cat_pull 0, 1, 2, 0

sprites.name: Back gear · r 7 art px
sprites.note: 8 teeth. Turns only while a rotate button is held: 1/4 tooth per 1/12 s, neighbours counter-rotate (mech_gears). Positions in MECH.GEARS

sprites.name: NEXT sign (blank plate)
sprites.note: Top-left art (168, 32) left-hand / (24, 32) right-hand; never flipped. sign_label "NEXT" in the plate (0, 1, 40, 16)

sprites.name: B · fire button · up
sprites.note: Top-left art (125, 70). Down on dog_press frame 2. In front of the dog

sprites.name: B · fire button · down
sprites.note: Top-left art (125, 70). Down on dog_press frame 2. In front of the dog

sprites.name: Shot timer pip
sprites.note: 12 around the pointer at r 36.7 pt, clockwise from the top, one per second left. Tint pipOn; pipHot with a 4 fps flash in the last 4 s; spent pips pipOff

sprites.name: Aim-line dot
sprites.note: 9 pt dot every 20 pt along the traced path, scrolling at 30 pt/s (aim_dots)

sprites.name: A · crank handle knob
sprites.note: Drawn after the dog so it sits in the jaws; orbits the crank center at 3.3 pt

sprites.name: A · fire lever base
sprites.note: Pivot = lever pivot art (137, 81). Behind the cat
